title: Your exchange
protocolNote: Use practice supplies. Your care team’s routine has not been added yet.

checks.title: Get the space ready
checks.prompt: Let's get your space ready. Check the airflow around your work area. Say 'done' when you've finished, or ask me a question.
checks.help: Check your work area using the room setup instructions you were taught. I can't see the rest of the room from here.
exampleResponses: Done, I've checked the space and airflow.
Can you remind me what to check here?

checks.title: Check the bag
checks.prompt: Read the bag's name, strength, amount and expiry date. You can give them together or a little at a time. I'll keep what you've told me and ask only for anything missing.
checks.help: Compare the label with your written instructions, and check the bag and packaging. I can read visible text if you say read the label. You'll still need to check it yourself.
exampleResponses: The name is [read the name], strength [read the strength], amount [read the volume], and expiry [read the date].
The expiry is [read the date].
Yes, those details match my written instructions.
No, the amount I said needs correcting.

checks.title: Put on your mask
checks.prompt: Put on your mask the way you were taught. Say 'done' when it's on.
checks.help: Do this before cleaning your hands. You don't need to move the phone to show me your face.
exampleResponses: Done, my mask is on.

checks.title: Clean your hands
checks.prompt: Next, clean and dry your hands using the method you were taught. Take your time. Say 'done' when you've finished.
checks.help: Use your care team's hand cleaning instructions, including any hand sanitizer step they taught you. Hand tracking can't tell whether your hands are clean.
exampleResponses: Done, I've cleaned and dried my hands.
I need more time.

checks.title: Keep the openings clear
checks.prompt: Before we connect, name the openings that need to stay untouched in a short sentence. I'll read your answer back, then ask you to say 'ready' to continue or 'no' to go over it again.
checks.help: Think about the exposed connector opening and the inside of the new cap. Keep fingers, clothing and other surfaces away from them.
exampleResponses: The exposed connector opening and the inside of the new cap need to stay untouched.
Ready.
No, let's go over that again.

checks.title: Connect
checks.prompt: When you're ready to practise the connection step, say 'ready'.
checks.help: The phone analyzes the camera locally and sends experimental distance cues to your wristband. The detector can miss a close approach; it cannot confirm contact or sterility. Say 'ready' to practise, then 'done' when you've finished.
exampleResponses: Ready.
Done, I've finished practising the connection.
Pause.

checks.title: Follow your exchange steps
checks.prompt: Follow the next steps in your exchange instructions. Say 'done' when you're ready to practise disconnecting.
checks.help: Use the sequence and timings you were taught. I don't have your prescribed treatment settings.
exampleResponses: Done, I'm ready to practise disconnecting.
I have a question before we continue.

checks.title: Get ready to disconnect
checks.prompt: Get the supplies ready for disconnecting, and repeat the hand preparation you were taught. Say 'done' when you've finished.
checks.help: This is a new preparation check. Don't assume the earlier hand cleaning still covers everything you've touched since then.
exampleResponses: Done, my supplies and hand preparation are ready.

checks.title: Disconnect
checks.prompt: When you're ready to practise the disconnection step, say 'ready'.
checks.help: Keep the opening and new cap clear while following your practice steps. Experimental distance cues may miss a close approach. Say 'ready' to begin, then 'done' when you've finished.
exampleResponses: Ready.
Done, I've finished practising the disconnection.

checks.title: Finish up
checks.prompt: That's the end of this practice. Is there anything you'd like to go back over? If not, say 'all done'.
checks.help: You can ask about a step or tell me anything that felt unclear. For a real exchange concern, use the contact instructions from your care team.
exampleResponses: All done.
Can we go back over the bag check?

voice.action_report: Say 'done' when you've finished, or ask a question.
voice.bag_details: Read whichever bag details you have: name, strength, amount or expiry. You can add the rest in another reply; I'll keep the earlier details.
voice.openings_details: Name the openings in a short sentence. I'll read your answer back, then ask you to say 'ready' or 'no'.
voice.bag_confirmation: Do those details match your written instructions? You can say yes, correct anything I heard, or add a missing detail.
voice.openings_confirmation: Say 'ready' to continue, or 'no' to go over the openings again.
voice.ready_to_monitor: Say 'ready' when both hands and the opening are in view, or say 'pause'.
voice.finished_or_pause: Say 'done' when you've finished, or say 'pause'.
voice.resume_or_question: Say 'resume' when you're ready, or ask a question.
voice.contact_review: Pause and follow your care team's instructions about possible contact.
voice.none: Ask a question if there's anything you'd like to go over.
voice.confirmation_retry: We're still confirming what I read back. {instruction}
voice.bag_correction: I've kept the earlier details. Tell me what needs correcting; you don't need to start over.
voice.unmonitored_ready: The camera preview and distance warnings are experimental. Say 'ready' to practise this step, then 'done' when you've finished.
voice.unmonitored_active: Say 'done' when you've finished, or 'pause' if you need a moment.
